paper_title: The ORGAN Experiment: An axion haloscope above 15 GHz
notes: ORGAN pathfinding run, static TM020 cavity at 26.531 GHz (110 ueV). Limit g_agamma = 2.02e-12 GeV^-1 at 90% CL over a ~2.5 neV Lorentzian span. Note the abstract/conclusion typographically write 'eV^-1' but the exclusion plot (Fig. 3) y-axis is GeV^-1, and '50x KSVZ' cross-check confirms GeV^-1. Very narrow single-mass limit; encoded as a two-point near-degenerate line at 1.1e-4 eV. DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 was used for the projections (Stage I); pathfinder assumed standard halo.
